live_scope.symbol_cap_policy: BTC_then_frozen_scan_liquidity_priority; all missing coverage explicit; candidate selection uncapped by observer
live_scope.funding_history_rest: one request per 5 minutes for closed observations; same Bybit scanner cooldown; only outside scan window with 30 second guard
live_scope.network_failure: signal worker continues; observation gaps explicit
live_scope.funding_live_distribution: indicative hourly samples, not settled history; historical parity unverified

cohort.start: first post-release Telegram ACK with persistent delivered_at_ms
cohort.old_messages: retained in source, excluded from prospective results without ACK timestamp
cohort.anchor: first full minute strictly after ACK+2 seconds
cohort.missing_path: UNRESOLVED_DATA, never normal win/loss; pessimistic sensitivity separate
cohort.repeated_notifications: one candidate id per venue/config/symbol/signal candle; account and candidate counts separate
cohort.controls: all assessed rejected peers preserved; descriptive, not randomized or matched efficacy controls

costs.funding: settled Bybit rate times preceding observed mark max90s; missing mark/rate => model net absent
costs.liquidity: best quotes recorded, full-size historical depth unverified
costs.performance_label: technical path and counterfactual cost model, never executed fills or verified profitability
costs.funding_timing: entry/exiting-minute settlement ambiguity leaves model net unresolved

H1.feature: closed trigger candle taker buy quote / total quote

H2.feature: 4h OI unit change >0 AND directional 4h price return >0
H2.meaning: OI is outstanding contracts, not proof of net money inflow or long direction

H3.feature: latest available settled funding rank vs previous 30 calendar days, excluding current
H3.warmup: complete expected settlement history; live indicative ranks cannot substitute

H4.feature: coin 72h return minus BTC 72h return on same closed 4h grid

historical_plan.control_matching: same venue,time eligibility,liquidity and missing-data mask; explicit matched and native coverage reports
historical_plan.cost_stress: same admitted events at base and 1.5x fees/slippage; funding unchanged
pass_conditions: positive mean net R at 1.5x costs
positive mean net R after removing three symbols with highest total net R in that arm
paired day-mean advantage over BOTH random controls with 95% day-block confidence interval lower bound >0; Holm correction across 8 comparisons
at least 60 observed entry-day clusters; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; no sample count guarantees power
reporting: BTC up/sideways/down with preregistered regime definitions before replay
unresolved counts and pessimistic stop sensitivity
number of trials and prior exposures
fixed-seed controls and secondary seed sensitivity
historical_plan.promotion: separate version after independent review; never auto-enable filters
historical_plan.btc_regime_definition: closed 4h BTC return >+0.5% up, <-0.5% down, otherwise sideways; observational segmentation only

no_claims: positive funding proves everyone is long
same August replay is independent evidence
